Mara pulled out her pen, tucking a small photo of the lighthouse into a fresh bottle, and set it adrift as the sun broke through the thinning storm clouds.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市浸在凉润的墨色里，路灯拖着昏黄的光晕，把空荡的柏油路烘得发暖。偶尔有夜班出租车缓缓驶过，轮胎碾过枯叶的轻响飘得很远。临街早餐铺已经亮灯，蒸笼的白气顺着半开的窗飘到巷口，混着刚烤好的麦香。远处高楼的轮廓还沉在薄雾里，零星几扇窗亮着，是失眠的人，还是赶早行程的过客？风掠过行道树叶，将将醒未醒的城市揉得软和。", "w03": "- Recursion is when you solve a big, tricky problem by breaking it into smaller, identical versions of the exact same problem.\n- Every recursive problem has a clear 'base case' — the tiniest version you can answer immediately, no more breaking needed, like knowing how many cookies you have when you hold just one.\n- You build up the big answer by combining the answers from all the small pieces, like stacking single blocks one by one to build a full play tower."}
